name: keyzii
description_en:
keyzii is a product in the Team collaboration category. Its directory profile covers Synchronous Editing, Group Calendars, Discussion Boards, Chat (Messaging), Brainstorming, Audio Video Conferencing, Content Management, Task Management.

Additional listed capabilities include Contact Management, Document Management. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large). API support is listed as NA. Support channels are listed as Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Available Starts at $39.99. Offers Free-forever plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: exchange messages within the supported workspace; organize content through creation, revision and publication; create, assign and track units of work; store and organize people, organizations and their contact details; organize documents and control their access and revisions. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
description_zh:
keyzii 属于团队协作软件。第三方资料列出的功能包括同步编辑、群组日历、讨论区、聊天消息、头脑风暴、音视频会议、内容管理、任务管理。

资料还列出联系人管理、文档管理。选择时应结合实际任务、使用权限和数据处理需求逐项评估。

资料所列运行方式为浏览器访问（云服务）。资料所列适用组织规模为小型、中型与大型组织。API 支持情况为未注明。资料所列支持方式为在线支持。

第三方定价快照显示：提供免费试用 起价为 $39.99. 另有持续免费方案。。这属于采集时的第三方参考，实际金额、计费周期、试用条件及地区可用性仍需核对官网。

根据这些功能，可重点评估以下任务：在受支持的工作空间中交换消息；组织内容的创建、修订和发布；创建、分配并跟踪具体工作任务；集中保存和整理联系人、组织及其联系方式；整理文档并管理访问权限与版本。这些是基于功能的使用场景建议，不能当作实际客户采用的证据。
